attributes.title: About this dashboard
attributes.visState:
{"title": "About this dashboard", "type": "markdown", "aggs": [], "params": {"fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": true, "markdown": "## Meridian Sentinel — Fraud Detection Overview

This board shows, in plain language, how the system is protecting customer accounts right now.

- **Total Transactions Processed** — every payment the system checked.
- **Suspected Fraud Detected** — payments the system flagged as unusual.
- **Security Incidents Raised** — flagged cases sent to a human analyst to review.

In the charts below, **green means safe** and **red means flagged for review**. Use the date picker at the top right to change the time period."}}
